messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Continuous integration now up!
parts:
You can find the status of our build at:

http://d1m1s1b1.stat.columbia.edu:8080/


I was able to install Jenkins on the Windows machine on the 9th floor
office. It pulls the source from Google Code and compiles with g++
version 4. As of now, it polls Google Code every 5 minutes. I had to
fix a few things in the code, but it seems to be ok. The nice thing is
that we are able to run the unit tests on a Windows machine. When Stan
grows up, we may want to move this to a hosted service. For now, I
think it'll suffice.

I haven't played with any of the configuration, so I haven't pulled
the results of the unit tests up to the web.

Daniel

messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Continuous integration now up!

run thing if it wants to run the tests, too!

- Bob

messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Continuous integration now up!
parts:
Yeah, that could be an issue. It's very easy to set the polling
frequency. And, if we need, we can have the SVN push a notification
out to Jenkins when it has been updated.

For now, I'm going to pretend that the problem doesn't exist or is
easily fixed in the future.


Daniel


PS. I've been making some changes to the makefiles (hopefully for the better).
